# Learners Academy
> Online tuition for Cambridge (CAIE), Edexcel and AQA IGCSE, O Level and
> A Level. Live small-group and 1-to-1 classes. Teaching since 2016.
> Based in Bahria Town, Lahore; students across Pakistan, Saudi Arabia,
> the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman and the UK. 23 subjects.
> First class free. WhatsApp +92 323 9149918.

- [Teachers](https://learnersacademy.com.pk/teachers/): 19 named faculty, 273+ years combined experience
- [Saudi Arabia](https://learnersacademy.com.pk/igcse-tuition/saudi-arabia/): online IGCSE/A Level tuition for KSA families
- [Dubai & UAE](https://learnersacademy.com.pk/igcse-tuition/dubai/): online IGCSE/A Level tuition for UAE families
- [Pakistani expats hub](https://learnersacademy.com.pk/pakistani-expats/): UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, UK
- [Subjects](https://learnersacademy.com.pk/subjects/): all 23 subjects across Cambridge, Edexcel and AQA
